description: The M2 matrix: every element type with a background colour at every fillStyle (hachure, cross-hatch, zigzag, solid) x roughness 0, 1, 2 x seed 1, 7, 1041657908. Rectangles sharp and at roundness 3, diamonds sharp and at roundness 2, ellipses, iframes, embeddables, line loops (sharp, curved) and polygon lines, arrows (sharp, curved) with a filled triangle end head, freedraw loops at variable and constant width; text, image, frame, magicframe and stickynote have no shape.
